arguments.point: Even the lighter case stays positive. A net present value of {{npv_flows_minus_10}} if cash flows are a tenth light, and a net present value of {{npv_flows_minus_20}} if they are a fifth light, remain above zero. Payback of {{payback_years}} years is within the policy limit of {{max_payback_years}} years.
cited_assumptions: Maintenance costs are included in the annual cash flows.

top_risk: A deeper volume drop than the stress cases is not in the model.
questions_for_sponsor: Which measured overtime study supports the savings?
